message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. Facts: Wang sued for non-payment of civil judgment. Court ordered him to pay 7700 yuan. He didn't comply, refused to report assets, despite ability. Execution notice, report asset order, fine of 5000 yuan, still didn't comply. After, he fulfilled obligations. So the conduct: refusal to comply with court judgment, failure to report assets, obstructing execution. This is likely "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" which in Chinese criminal law is "拒不执行判决、裁定罪". The label in list? Not directly present. However similar to "经济犯"? No. Could be "妨害作证"? No. "妨害公务"? Not exactly. The list includes "妨害作证", "妨害公务". The crime of refusing to execute judgment is under "妨害公务"? Actually, refusing to execute a court order is considered "妨害公务" (obstructing public administration). In Chinese criminal law, article 277: "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" is a separate offense, but not in list. The list may have "妨害公务" which covers obstruction of public administration. So likely label: "妨害公务". Also there is a fine imposed by court, but that's administrative. The criminal charge is for refusing to execute. So answer: [罪名]妨害公务<eoa>.
